title: XP/level curve and per-level bonuses
description: G3: the player's XP curve and the flat per-level bonus percentage applied to attack_speed/cast_speed/max_health, compounded multiplicatively across levels. Loaded identically by the Godot client; the Go server does not read this file today (see docs/0017). Killing a monster grants its monsters.json xp_reward.

schema_version.description: Bumped on any breaking change to this file's shape.

max_level.description: The level at which XP gain stops raising the level further (the bar shows full/maxed).

xp_base.description: XP required to go from level 1 to level 2 (ProgressionCurve.xp_base * xp_growth^0).

xp_growth.description: Multiplier applied to the xp-to-next-level requirement per level (xp_base * xp_growth^(level-1)). Must exceed 1 so the curve strictly increases.

level_bonus_pct.description: Percentage bonus to attack_speed/cast_speed/max_health per level, compounded multiplicatively: effective multiplier at level L is (1 + level_bonus_pct/100)^(L-1). See ProgressionCurve.bonus_contribution and docs/0017 for how this feeds PlayerStats.compose.
